title: MINI-CHALLENGE: Complete Ship Validation Suite

story.setup: MENTOR-9: "Time to prove your validation mastery. Create a comprehensive diagnostic that checks EVERYTHING—status, errors, thresholds, collections. Leave no system unverified."
story.requirements: Build a complete validation suite using all assertion types: equality, contains, boolean, numeric, length, and collection checks. This mirrors real-world test scenarios.
story.success: MENTOR-9: "Outstanding! That's a production-grade validation suite. Chapter 1 complete—you can communicate, store data, and validate it. The ship's basic diagnostics are online. Now we organize complex test suites."

description: Create a comprehensive validation suite that integrates ALL Section 1.3 assertion concepts.
requirements: Use all 6+ assertion types learned in Section 1.3
Validate scalars with Should Be Equal
Validate boolean conditions with Should Be True/False
Validate numeric ranges with Should Be Greater/Less Than
Validate collection sizes with Length Should Be
Validate collection contents with List/Dictionary assertions
Demonstrate assertion keyword flexibility (lowercase or uppercase variation)
All assertions must pass for challenge to succeed
constraints: At least 6 different assertion keyword types
Must validate at least one list and one dictionary
Must include at least one numeric comparison
Must include at least one boolean check
At least one assertion keyword must use non-standard case (lowercase/uppercase)
All variables must follow naming conventions
instructions: Create *** Variables *** section with constants: ${SHIP_NAME} = 'Starlight Explorer', ${MAX_TEMP} = 100, ${MIN_POWER} = 50
Create *** Test Cases *** section with test named 'Complete Ship Validation'
Validate ship name: Create ${ship_name} and verify it equals ${SHIP_NAME}
Validate error message: Create ${error} = 'Critical hull breach in sector 7' and verify it contains 'breach'
Validate status report: Create ${report} = 'Diagnostic: 3 warnings, 1 critical error' and verify it contains 'critical'
Validate temperature: Create ${temp} = 75 and verify it's less than ${MAX_TEMP}
Validate power: Create ${power} = 60 and verify it's greater than ${MIN_POWER}
Validate boolean: Create ${repairs_done} = ${True} and verify it's True
Validate list: Create @{systems} with 5 items, verify length is 5, verify it contains 'Navigation'
Validate dictionary: Create &{status} with 3 pairs, verify it has key 'Power', verify it has key 'Navigation'
Demonstrate flexibility: Use at least one assertion in lowercase (e.g., 'should be equal') or uppercase
hints: *** Variables *** section must come before *** Test Cases ***
Use constants from *** Variables *** in your test
Don't forget to use ${list} notation with Length Should Be, not @{list}
All assertions must pass for the challenge to succeed
solution:
*** Variables ***
${SHIP_NAME}     Starlight Explorer
${MAX_TEMP}      100
${MIN_POWER}     50

*** Test Cases ***
Complete Ship Validation
    # Equality checks
    ${ship_name}           Set Variable    Starlight Explorer
    Should Be Equal        ${ship_name}    ${SHIP_NAME}
    
    # Substring checks
    ${error}               Set Variable    Critical hull breach in sector 7
    Should Contain         ${error}    breach
    
    ${report}              Set Variable    Diagnostic: 3 warnings, 1 critical error
    SHOULD CONTAIN         ${report}    critical
    
    # Numeric comparisons
    ${temp}                Set Variable    75
    Should Be Less Than    ${temp}    ${MAX_TEMP}
    
    ${power}               Set Variable    60
    Should Be Greater Than    ${power}    ${MIN_POWER}
    
    # Boolean check
    ${repairs_done}        Set Variable    ${True}
    Should Be True         ${repairs_done}
    
    # List validation
    @{systems}             Create List    Navigation    Power    Life Support    Communications    Sensors
    Length Should Be       ${systems}    5
    List Should Contain Value    ${systems}    Navigation
    
    # Dictionary validation
    &{status}              Create Dictionary    Navigation=OFFLINE    Power=CRITICAL    Life_Support=OPERATIONAL
    Dictionary Should Contain Key    ${status}    Power
    Dictionary Should Contain Key    ${status}    Navigation
    
    Log                    Complete validation suite passed!
successCriteria: *** Variables *** section with at least 3 constants
*** Test Cases *** section with comprehensive test
Boolean assertion (Should Be True or Should Be False)
At least one assertion using non-standard case

conceptsIntegrated: Should Be Equal - exact value comparison
Should Be Greater/Less Than - numeric ranges
Should Be Empty - empty collection check
List Should Contain Value - list membership
Dictionary Should Contain Key - dictionary key validation
